items.label: Landing and raw containers
items.description: The meter vendor drops one CSV folder per day in landing/; Data Factory copies it to raw/ as parquet.

items.label: Copy the drop to raw
items.description: Pipeline pl_copy_meter_drop (landing CSV to raw parquet). The factory is declared in infra; its pipeline JSON is not in Git yet.

items.label: Daily meter readings (DAG)
items.description: Sensor, copy, Spark jobs, SQL models, quality check, publish.

items.label: Clean meter readings (PySpark)
items.description: Raw parquet to silver.meter_readings: types, invalid readings dropped, resends deduplicated, meter joined to site.

items.label: Daily site energy (PySpark)
items.description: silver.meter_readings to gold.site_energy_daily: per-band energy, 7-day rolling average, rank per region.

items.label: Delta tables (silver, gold)
items.description: Unity Catalog tables stored in the lakehouse container.

items.label: Warehouse models (SQL)
items.description: dim_site, fct_site_energy_daily and rpt_sites_over_contract, run on the Databricks SQL warehouse.

items.label: Energy API (container)
items.description: Read-only FastAPI over the published extract.

items.label: Energy report (placeholder)
items.description: A Power BI report over the gold tables; nothing built yet.

items.description: Declarations only; checked with what-if, deployed by a person.
